content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user with a personal to-do list","i_want":"to view my task list with a status indicator and a priority indicator on each task","so_that":"I can see the state and urgency of every task at a glance on the to-do management page","business_description":"The to-do management page shows the user's tasks in a list. Each row shows the task's status (Open, In Progress or Completed) and priority (Low, Medium or High). The list shows a loading state while the request is pending, an empty state when there are no tasks, and an error state when the request fails. The list reloads from the backend after a successful task change.","business_value":"Users can see which tasks are open, in progress or completed, and how urgent each one is, without opening each task. Clear loading, empty and error states show the user whether the list is current.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"The user has at least one task stored in the task list","when":"The user opens the to-do management page","then":"The task list view shows one row for each stored task, and each row has a status indicator and a priority indicator"},{"given":"A task has status Open, In Progress or Completed","when":"The task list view renders that task","then":"The status indicator shows the task's status text exactly as stored and a visual mark that differs for each of the three status values"},{"given":"A task has priority Low, Medium or High","when":"The task list view renders that task","then":"The priority indicator shows the task's priority text exactly as stored and a visual mark that differs for each of the three priority values"},{"given":"The task list request to the backend has not yet completed","when":"The task list view is displayed","then":"A loading state is shown, and no task rows and no empty-state text are shown"},{"given":"The backend returns an empty task list","when":"The task list view receives the response","then":"The empty state is shown, and no task rows are shown"},{"given":"The task list request to the backend fails with a non-success response","when":"The task list view receives the failure","then":"The error state is shown with a message, the loading state is no longer shown, and no task rows and no empty-state text are shown"},{"given":"The backend returns an internal server or database error for the task list request","when":"The task list view receives the error response","then":"The error state is shown, and no task rows and no empty-state text are shown"},{"given":"The task list is displayed and the user creates, updates, deletes or changes the status of a task","when":"The backend confirms that the change succeeded","then":"The task list is reloaded from the backend and shows the changed task without a manual page refresh"},{"given":"The task list is displayed and the user creates, updates, deletes or changes the status of a task","when":"The backend request for the change fails","then":"The task list does not show the change as applied, and the list is not reloaded as if the change had succeeded"},{"given":"Tasks are stored in the backend and a client calls GET /tasks","when":"The backend receives the request","then":"The backend returns every stored task in the list response, and the response contains no task data beyond the stored task fields"},{"given":"A task ID that does not exist is requested","when":"The backend read-by-ID endpoint GET /tasks/{id} is called","then":"The backend returns a task-not-found error with no task data"}],"edge_cases":["The PRD does not state user ownership, authentication or per-user scoping of tasks. This story returns all stored tasks and does not filter by user. Whether each task belongs to one user is an open question for the product owner.","The PRD does not define the visual mark for each status and priority value. The exact icons, colours or labels are an open question; the only requirement is that the three values of each indicator look different.","The PRD does not define the wording of the loading, empty or error messages. The exact wording is an open question.","The task list is empty and the backend returns an empty list: the empty state is shown instead of an error.","The backend returns an error for a task list request: the error state is shown and the previously loaded rows are not kept as current data.","A task change request that fails leaves the list unchanged and does not show a success message."],"dependencies":["US-create-task"],"definition_of_done":["GET /tasks returns all stored tasks and GET /tasks/{id} returns the task or a task-not-found error, both tested","The task list view shows a row with status and priority indicators for every task returned by the backend","Loading, empty and error states are each shown in the view and each is covered by a test","The list reloads from the backend after a successful create, update, delete or status change and does not reload as applied after a failure","No task row is added, removed or changed in the UI before the backend confirms the change","Open questions on user ownership, indicator visuals and message wording are recorded in the story"]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"tasks-read-endpoints","title":"[BE] Add GET /tasks and GET /tasks/{id} read endpoints with not-found handling","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Add a GET /tasks endpoint that returns all stored tasks and a GET /tasks/{id} endpoint that returns one task by ID. Return a task-not-found error when the ID does not exist, and an internal error response when the database fails. Do not filter by user, because user ownership is not defined in the PRD.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-244669c0","R-9dc414dc"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["GET /tasks returns all stored tasks in a list","GET /tasks/{id} returns the task when the ID exists","GET /tasks/{id} returns a task-not-found error with no task data when the ID does not exist","A database failure returns an internal error response","Endpoints are covered by backend tests"]},{"key_slug":"task-list-view","title":"[FE] Build the task list view with status and priority indicators","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Build the task list view on the to-do management page. It calls GET /tasks, shows one row per task with a status indicator and a priority indicator, and shows the loading, empty and error states.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-eed06908","R-4bed9064","R-60e02b8e","R-48c89e9e","R-d7e6667f"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["The view calls GET /tasks and renders one row per returned task","Each row shows the status text and a distinct visual mark for Open, In Progress and Completed","Each row shows the priority text and a distinct visual mark for Low, Medium and High","Loading state is shown while the request is pending and hidden when it completes","Empty state is shown when the list is empty and no rows are shown","Error state with a message is shown on failure and no rows are shown"]},{"key_slug":"task-list-auto-refresh","title":"[FE] Refresh the task list after a successful task change","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"After the backend confirms a successful create, update, delete or status change, reload the task list from GET /tasks.
